protocol: Payload Server 3-byte header (Type/CommandID/Length) carried as CCSDS TC_Data under APID 5
description: Payload Server command set per 'Command and Data Format Specification'. Frame = [3-bit Message Type | 10-bit Command ID | 11-bit Length] + Data. The Command ID is also carried in the CCSDS TC_ID field. Telecommand and telemetry share one port.

messages.name: Container_Operation_ON
messages.description: Enable (start) the payload container. Data carries the target Payload ID.

messages.name: Container_Operation_OFF
messages.description: Disable (stop) the payload container. Data carries the target Payload ID.

messages.name: Custom_Payload_Sequence
messages.description: Run a named operation on a payload. Fixed 3-byte prefix followed by the operation name (max 16 chars) then the arguments (max 128 chars).

parameters.name: Payload Operation Sequence Length
parameters.description: Length in bytes of the operation name that follows (max 16)

parameters.name: Payload Parameters Length
parameters.description: Length in bytes of the arguments that follow (max 128)

messages.name: Capture_MSI
messages.doc_reference: Spec §3.2 — Capture, Command ID 601, target MSI
messages.description: Trigger a capture on MSI. Target is implied by the Command ID. No data required; capture parameters may be appended if applicable.

messages.name: Capture_SCANWAY
messages.doc_reference: Spec §3.2 — Capture, Command ID 602, target SCANWAY
messages.description: Trigger a capture on SCANWAY. Target is implied by the Command ID. No data required; capture parameters may be appended if applicable.

messages.name: Container_Operation_ON_RSP
messages.description: Telemetry response to Container Operation ON. Data field layout is not defined in the specification; bytes are surfaced raw.

messages.name: Container_Operation_OFF_RSP
messages.description: Telemetry response to Container Operation OFF. Data field layout is not defined in the specification; bytes are surfaced raw.

messages.name: Custom_Payload_Sequence_RSP
messages.description: Telemetry response to a Custom Payload Sequence. Data field layout is not defined in the specification; bytes are surfaced raw.

messages.name: Capture_MSI_RSP
messages.description: Telemetry response to an MSI capture. Data field layout is not defined in the specification; bytes are surfaced raw.

messages.name: Capture_SCANWAY_RSP
messages.description: Telemetry response to a SCANWAY capture. Data field layout is not defined in the specification; bytes are surfaced raw.
